_comment: Every Microsoft page this skill reads, one entry per source.
strategy 'raw'   -> fetch_url is the Learn article source on GitHub.
strategy 'learn' -> fetch_url is the rendered Learn page, used where the
source repository is not publicly mirrored.
live_url is always the citable Learn URL that appears in the output.

pg_compute.reads: Burstable / General Purpose / Memory Optimized server types with vCores, memory, IOPS.

pg_overview.reads: Compute tier guidance and the V6 SKU family preview status.

mysql_tiers.reads: Burstable / General Purpose / Business Critical compute sizes and tier guidance.

redis_whats_new.reads: Dated release history and the retirement timetable for every tier.

appservice_plans.reads: Pricing tier categories - shared, dedicated and isolated compute - and what each is for.

aks_tiers.reads: Free / Standard / Premium pricing tiers, when to use each, and node limits.

vm_sizes.reads: The VM size family list per workload type. This page is the entry point: the provider follows it to each family page, then to each series page, and reads the 'Sizes in series' Basics table on every one - roughly 130 pages - to get individual sizes.

ddb_compute.reads: The cluster-tier table (M10-M200 with vCores and RAM per shard), the burstable-tier description, and the configuration guidance.

ddb_overview.reads: What the service is and when Microsoft positions it.

ddb_free.reads: The Free Tier SKU: what it includes and its restrictions.

ddb_release.reads: Service release notes, including the November 2025 rename from Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB (vCore).
